records.subject: Need for a scientific and sustainable and future-elevated railway solution to urban congestion in Belagavi City, Karnataka.
records.SM_Text:
Shri M. Nagaraja:

     Belagavi stands at a critical juncture in its urban mobility and development. Elevated Railway Tracks on viaducts throughout the city would permanently eliminate crippling railway-gate bottlenecks, safeguard daily commuters, and accelerate Belagavi?s evolution into a modern, gridlock-free smart city without disturbing established commercial precincts. Existing Railway Over Bridges in densely inhabited areas have not adequately responded to sound urban-planning imperatives and have generated concerns regarding safety, accessibility, congestion and community convenience. Proposed 9-kilometre Elevated Railway Track Project on viaducts would constitute a comprehensive, scientifically conceived and future-ready urban transport intervention, designed to eliminate all nine existing level crossings within Belagavi City. It would reduce ground-level disruption and dependence upon intrusive ROBs; enhance public safety; ensure unhindered movement of ambulances and emergency services; facilitate heavy-vehicle mobility; strengthen long-term infrastructure planning and strategic connectivity; improve accessibility and urban aesthetics; enable urban renewal and economic revitalisation; preserve the environment; protect Belagavi?s cultural and heritage sensitivity. Successful precedents demonstrate practicability. The Kurukshetra Elevated Railway Track was undertaken to bypass five manned level crossings in central Kurukshetra, while the proposed Mandhana?Anwarganj elevated railway corridor in Kanpur seeks to eliminate numerous level crossings.

          This project is not merely an infrastructural intervention, but a decisive commitment to improving citizens? quality of life amid increasing population and vehicular density. With the visionary leadership and foresight of Hon?ble Prime Minister. I earnestly urge the Government to consider and sanction the ?Elevated Railway Track Project on Viaducts across Belagavi City?.

(ENDS)
